SCANNER_QR_GENERATOR_DESCRIPTION: Generate a QR code to configure ROOM_ID, STATION_ID, and DEVICE_ID on a scanner.
SCANNER_QR_PRINT_NOTE: This QR is intended for station/device assignment only and does not include secrets.

SCANNER_QR_PRINT_SUBTITLE: Scan this code to configure the scanner station settings.
